ticket: T59, the headliner's own figure: candidates for the owner to choose from, none of them in the game
note: raw/ keeps the stills as returned (768 pixels, twelve to a sprite pixel, every cell one colour). Three ideas, two stills each. The marquee's first two came back one squat (44 x 46 sprite pixels, shorter than the magician's 63) and one cut by the frame's edges, so two more were asked for 'a very tall man with long legs ... the whole of him inside the frame with a small empty margin all round', and the second of them (41 x 61) is the pick. Two walks: of the squat one (three rows of three frames of 50 x 52) and of the pick (frames of 44 x 66), a file pixel to a sprite pixel, as returned with --frame-size 64. The squat walk exported again with --frame-size 96 came back at exactly twice the size (frames of 100 x 104), which is no size the game has: not kept. sheet.png sets every candidate beside the magician and the rival's understudy on the boards' colour, and walk.gif is the pick's walk four times its size; both were made from these files by a script that is not in the repository. A job that returned two pictures is listed twice with the credits of the whole job.
